title: Business Analyst Quality Control Solutions- Setlab
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst Quality Control Solutions \- Setlab to join the Manufacturing \& Quality Technology organization and play a key role in delivering Sandoz's Digital Quality Strategy. In this role, you will partner with global Quality Control, Manufacturing, and Technology stakeholders to analyse business processes, define system requirements, and drive the implementation and continuous improvement of QC laboratory solutions, including LIMS, CDS, LabX, and related platforms. You will lead requirements gathering, process modelling, system validation, and deployment activities while ensuring compliance with GxP, CSV, and regulatory standards. The successful candidate will combine strong business analysis capabilities with deep knowledge of quality and laboratory systems to deliver innovative, data\-driven solutions that enhance operational efficiency, support global quality processes, and enable business transformation across a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Act as a trusted advisor to global Quality Control (QC) and Manufacturing stakeholders, identifying opportunities to improve processes, systems, and services through data\-driven analysis.
* Gather, analyse, and translate Quality Control business requirements into global system requirements, ensuring alignment with business objectives and digital quality initiatives.
* Lead and support global QC system implementation, enhancement, and rollout projects across laboratory and quality management platforms.
* Collaborate with business and technology teams to assess current processes, design future\-state solutions, and drive adoption of best practices.
* Author and maintain user requirement specifications (URS), ensuring traceability between business requirements, functional specifications, testing, and validation activities.
* Support computerized system validation (CSV), testing, qualification activities, and GxP compliance requirements for laboratory applications and QC systems.
* Develop reports, analyse system and project performance data, and provide actionable recommendations to improve operational efficiency and business value.
* Contribute to the QC technology strategy, roadmap, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring compliance with quality, security, and regulatory standards.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in manufacturing, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or process industry environments, with a strong focus on digital technologies and business process improvement.
* Proven experience working with Quality Control systems such as LIMS, CDS, LabX, or other laboratory informatics platforms.
* At least 3 years of experience delivering Quality IT or laboratory systems projects within a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Strong knowledge of Computerized System Validation (CSV), GxP regulations, and quality management processes.
* Demonstrated expertise in business analysis, requirements gathering, process mapping, and solution design.
* Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and managing cross\-functional collaboration in global, matrix organisations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language.
* Solid understanding of IT service lifecycle management, system implementation methodologies, testing, validation, and change management practices.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights\-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient\-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry\-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
   

  

 Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions
* Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation
* Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy
* Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance
* Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost\-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements
* Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations
* Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users
* Lead business analysis activities for medium to large\-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels
* Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies
* Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with advanced facilitation and presentation capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences
* Strong leadership capabilities including team mentoring, project coordination, decision\-making, and the ability to influence without authority
* Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical industry, or regulated environments with deep understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* A patient\-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 7 years of business analysis experience, with at least 3 years in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering and process improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* Experience with clinical systems implementation and configuration (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, etc.)
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical research (GCP, ICH, FDA, EMA)
* Experience with Agile and traditional software development methodologies
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, life sciences, or related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), IIBA certifications, or PMI\-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis)
* Training in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Background in implementing or optimizing clinical data management processes
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and facilitating decision\-making


 We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
   

  

 If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Data Analyst I
description:
**Description**
 Data Analyst I
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
   

  

 Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
   

  

 Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
**Primary Roles and Responsibilities**
* Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, including joins and Common Table Expressions (CTEs), for data extraction and transformation.
* Proven ability to lead client engagements and present complex findings.
* Able to work independently without the needs for close supervision and collaboratively as part of cross team efforts
* Extremely strong organizational and analytical skills with strong attention to details
* Ensure business logic and data quality checks are implemented and functioning correctly within ADF and Databricks pipelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data\-related issues by conducting detailed root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
* Ensure timely data delivery by tracking system performance and proactively addressing issues within defined SLAs.
* Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to support operational and analytical data needs.
* Maintain strong documentation practices to ensure continuity and clarity across the team.
* Work closely with Azure DevOps for CI/CD and understand release processes (Dev to Ops Handover) and have experience on release management.
* Understand data integrations with third\-party platforms such as Veeva CRM and Salesforce.
* Provide support during shift hours as per business requirements in EST time zones.
* Communicate effectively within team and across departments to align on objectives and tasks.


**Preferred Qualifications: \-**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of professional experience in data analysis, data engineering, or ETL processes.
* Must hold an Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP\-203\) certification.
* Databricks certifications are highly desirable.
* Experience with root cause analysis and troubleshooting in production environments
* Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills


**Technical Skills: \-**
* Primary Skills:
+ Azure Data Factory
+ Azure Databricks
+ Azure Logic Apps
+ Azure Data Lake Gen2(ADLS)
+ SQL
+ Python/PySpark

* Secondary Skills: \-
+ Unity Catalog
+ Lakehouse Architecture


* Nice to Have: \-
+ Salesforce
+ JIRA
+ Azure Key Vault
+ Azure Automation Account


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com

Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and technically proficient IT Data Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Data Engineering or ETL processes with hands\-on experience in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and SQL. This role will support business\-critical data integration and operational processes, ensuring smooth pipeline execution, system reliability, and timely data delivery. The analyst will also collaborate with stakeholders across IT and business functions to resolve issues, implement improvements, and ensure data integrity across platforms like Veeva CRM, Salesforce, and Azure\-based data systems

title: Global Head SAP BW and Analytics Platforms
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This role is accountable for shaping and delivering the global SAP BW and Analytics strategy, ensuring scalable, secure, and high\-performing data platforms that enable enterprise\-wide decision\-making and digital transformation.
   

  

 The Global Lead drives end\-to\-end ownership of solution architecture, demand governance, and vendor execution to deliver measurable business value from SAP analytics investments. This leadership role plays a critical part in enabling S/4HANA transformation and ensuring consistent, high\-quality analytics capabilities across regions and functions.
   

  

 The role provides strategic and visionary leadership for the SAP BW and Analytics domain by shaping the future\-state roadmap, governance model, SAP CoE alignment, investment priorities and budget discipline. It ensures that data, analytics and reporting capabilities are not only stable and compliant, but also positioned as strategic enablers for simplification, standardization, innovation, transformation readiness and measurable business value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**Major Accountabilities**
**Strategy, Roadmap and Business Value**
* Define and deliver the global SAP BW and Analytics strategy and roadmap, aligned with enterprise data, ERP and digital transformation priorities.
* Ensure SAP analytics investments are prioritized and delivered against clear business outcomes, value realization and enterprise\-wide adoption.
* Translate complex business needs into scalable analytics capabilities and continuous process improvements that strengthen decision\-making across functions and regions.


**Solution Architecture and Platform Excellence**
* Own end\-to\-end lifecycle accountability for SAP analytics platforms, from solution concept and design through delivery, optimization and continuous improvement.
* Support \& implement architectural direction and governance to ensure scalable, secure, compliant and future\-ready solutions across BW/4HANA and the broader analytics ecosystem.
* Enable successful integration with S/4HANA and related enterprise systems, ensuring consistent, reliable and high\-performing analytics capabilities.


**Data Governance, Risk and Operational Reliability**
* Establish and enforce data management, integration and interoperability standards that support trusted, consistent and reusable analytics across systems.
* Drive risk management, platform performance, reliability and security outcomes for global analytics platforms.
* Ensure demand, delivery and operational governance support stable BAU performance, transformation programs and M\&A integration requirements.


**Vendor, Delivery and Team Leadership**
* Lead the vendor ecosystem and delivery governance to secure high\-quality outcomes across projects, services and transformation initiatives.
* Build and lead a high\-performing global team of Solution Engineers and Solution Owners, strengthening accountability, collaboration and innovation.
* Create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and partnership with business and Technology stakeholders.
* Create executive\-level visibility through roadmap narratives, decision papers, governance dashboards, risk insights and value realisation updates that support senior leadership decisions.
